summary: This bill establishes a pilot program to award grants to eligible consortia for combating technological abuse in domestic violence cases and creates a separate grant program to provide education on technological abuse to organizations and individuals who support victims.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes pilot programs to combat technological abuse in domestic violence cases and to provide education on technological abuse. By focusing on supporting victims and preventing abuse through grants and educational programs, it aligns with a softer justice approach that emphasizes victim support and prevention rather than stricter punitive measures for offenders.
